tagline: Hand-picked bags, luggage, watches and travel essentials, plus simple travel guides and tools for travellers in India and around the world

books.seo_title: Travel books for India and abroad: guidebooks, phrasebooks, travel journals and kids' travel books
books.intro: Printed travel guidebooks, a phrasebook, travel journals, kids' travel books, story books for kids and travel stories that make good gifts. Every button goes to the printed edition. We read the edition, pages, size and language on each Amazon.in listing. Cover images come from the publishers' own shops and Open Library.
books.tip: Guidebooks are heavy: Lonely Planet India is listed at 850 g. On a cabin-bag-only trip, take one guidebook and keep the rest on your phone. On a long flight, an audiobook weighs nothing.

baby-kids.seo_title: Baby and kids travel essentials in India: travel stroller, diaper bag, baby carrier and kids' travel gear
baby-kids.intro: Travel gear for families with a baby or young kids: a stroller that folds small, a baby carrier, a diaper bag, a fold-up changing mat, a milk powder container, a kids' cabin trolley, volume-limited headphones and a kids' travel pillow, plus art kits, puzzles, a board game and baby toys for birthdays and return gifts. We read the folded size, weight, age range and colour on each Amazon.in listing, and only repeat safety facts the listing itself states.
baby-kids.tip: Indian airlines let a baby fly on your lap from a few days old until the day before the second birthday, with age proof such as a birth certificate. IndiGo and Akasa carry one stroller or pram per infant free, but give an infant no check-in allowance. For any question about your baby's health and flying, ask your paediatrician.

grooming.tip: A rechargeable trimmer can go in your cabin bag. In check-in it must be fully switched off, so a travel lock or a cap over the blade helps. Take any scissors out of the kit first: they aren't allowed in the cabin.
